footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to IDACORP: includes a $13.7M income tax benefit; after $661K attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 0.7% to $1.8B in 2025. Operating income rose 8.0% to $354M, a 19.5% margin.
Net income rose 11.9% to $323M, or $5.90 per share. Operating cash flow was $602M and free cash flow −$577M, versus −$415M; IDACORP returned $192M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: IDACORP, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
